summary: 3 E Network Technology Group Ltd (the Company) filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Share Subscription Agreement dated April 23, 2026, with hashbeaver tech Limited (the Target). The Company agreed to subscribe for 1,470,000 ordinary shares for a total consideration of US$1,470,000, based on a pre-money valuation of US$30,000,000. Upon completion and register update, the Company will hold 4.9% of the enlarged share capital. No board recommendation, advisors, or premium are disclosed. Payment is due within 30 days. This is a minority stake acquisition; watch for regulatory approvals and the Target's ongoing performance.
